title: Penpot: free Figma alternative
caption:
Figma charges $16/month for a full seat. Penpot lets you design app and website mockups for free 🎨

✅ Design screens right in your browser
✅ Link them into clickable prototypes
✅ Edit live with your team
✅ Developers can copy CSS and HTML straight from the design
✅ No subscription, no file limits, no lock-in

💻 Any browser
ℹ️ The free cloud plan is fully featured but capped at 8 team members and 10GB of storage. Paid plans add more, or you can host it yourself

Comment "MOCKUP" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #uidesign #figma #design #prototype #freeapps #techtips
